# Tidewater Jobs

> Tidewater Jobs is a hosted scheduler for data jobs: a cron replacement with retries, secrets and an HTTP API.

Docs pages are also available as Markdown by adding `.md` to the URL (for example https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/quick-start.md).

## Docs

- [Quick start](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/quick-start.md): First steps with Tidewater Jobs
- [Installation](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/install.md): How to install the tools
- [Job file reference](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/job-file.md): Structure and fields of a job file
- [Scheduling syntax](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/schedules.md): How to write job schedules
- [Retries and timeouts](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/retries.md): Retry and timeout behavior for jobs
- [Secrets](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/secrets.md): Storing and using secrets in jobs
- [HTTP API overview](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/api.md): Introduction to the HTTP API
- [API: jobs](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/api/jobs.md): Jobs endpoints
- [API: runs](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/api/runs.md): Runs endpoints
- [API: webhooks](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/api/webhooks.md): Webhooks endpoints
- [CLI reference](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/cli.md): Command-line reference
- [Migrating from 1.x](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/migrate-1x.md): Upgrade guide from version 1.x
- [Self-hosting](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/self-hosting.md): Running Tidewater Jobs on your own infrastructure
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/troubleshooting.md): Common problems and fixes
- [Glossary](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/glossary.md): Terms used in the product
- [FAQ](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/faq.md): Frequently asked questions
- [SDK: Python](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/sdk/python.md): Python SDK
- [SDK: Node](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/sdk/node.md): Node SDK
